'''巽'''（そん）は[[八卦]]の一つ。卦の形は[[画像:Son.png]]であり、初[[爻]]・第2爻は[[陰陽思想|陽]]、第3爻は陰で構成される。または[[六十四卦]]の一つであり、巽為風。巽上巽下で構成される。[[方角]]としては東南の方角になり、[[辰]]（たつ）と[[巳]]（み）の間であることから巽は「たつみ」とも読まれる。
== 卦象 == [[風]]（[[木]]）・入・[[鶏]]・股・長女などを象徴する。
[[Category:易|そん]]

[[納甲]]では[[辛]]、[[五行思想|五行]]の[[金]]、[[五方]]の[[西]]が当てられる。
== 先天図 == 伏羲先天八卦における次序は五であり、方位は四隅卦の一つで[[西南]]に配される。[[陰陽]]消息は一陰が生じたところである。

{{otheruses|Nine Stars of Divination|Nine Stars in Indian Astronomy|Nine Luminaries}} {{Cite source|date=December 2018}} {{color}} '''Nine Stars''' ({{ill|Nine Stars|ja|九星}}, Kyūsei) is a form of [[folk belief]] originating from ancient [[China]], consisting of nine stars: '''First White''', '''Second Black''', '''Third Blue''', '''Fourth Green''', '''Fifth Yellow''', '''Sixth White''', '''Seventh Red''', '''Eighth White''', and '''Ninth Purple'''.
The term "Nine Stars" can refer to several systems, and the one described here is specifically referred to as the "Purple White Nine Stars" or "Seven Colored Stars."
== Origin == The Nine Stars system originates from the following {{ill|magic square|ja|魔方陣}}:
{| class="wikitable" |- |Four||Nine||Two |- |Three||Five||Seven |- |Eight||One||Six |}
In this magic square, the sum of any row, column, or diagonal equals 15. It uses the numbers 1 through 9 exactly once in a 3×3 grid. This configuration, called the '''Later Heaven Arrangement''' ({{ill|Later Heaven Arrangement|ja|後天定位盤}}), is the only one of its kind, excluding rotations and reflections. These numbers are paired with seven colors (white, black, blue, green, yellow, red, and purple), the {{ill|five elements|ja|五行思想}} ({{ill|wood|ja|木}}, {{ill|fire|ja|火}}, {{ill|earth|ja|土}}, {{ill|metal|ja|金}}, and {{ill|water|ja|水}}), the {{ill|ten heavenly stems|ja|十干}}, the {{ill|twelve earthly branches|ja|十二支}}, and the {{ill|eight trigrams|ja|八卦}} of {{ill|I Ching|ja|易経}}. When these numbers shift positions, interpretations are added to form the "Nine Stars."
According to legend, {{ill|Yu the Great|ja|禹}}, founder of the {{ill|Xia Dynasty|ja|夏王朝}}, conceived this magic square when he encountered a sacred turtle emerging from the {{ill|Luo River|ja|洛水}}. This magic square is called the "Writing of the Luo" ({{ill|Luo Writing|ja|洛書}}), one of the {{ill|River Chart and Luo Writing|ja|河図洛書}}.
== The Nine Stars == In Japanese {{ill|Onmyōdō|ja|陰陽道}}, the following table associates the Nine Stars with the {{ill|five elements|ja|五行思想}}, {{ill|directions|ja|方位}}, {{ill|eight trigrams|ja|八卦}}, and colors, forming the '''Nine Stars Chart''' used to predict {{ill|fortune|ja|運勢}} and the {{ill|auspiciousness|ja|吉凶}} of directions based on a person's birth year.
{| class="wikitable" |- ! Star ! Reading ! Five Element ! Direction ! Eight Trigram ! {{otheruses|Nine Stars of Divination|Nine Stars in Indian Astronomy|Nine Luminaries]] {{Cite source|date=December 2018]] {| class="wikitable" |- | {{ill|Xun|en}}[[category:new pages]][[ja:巽]] |}
{| class="wikitable" |- | {{ill|Tai Chi|en}}[[category:new pages]][[ja:太極]] |- | {{ill|Qian|en}}[[category:new pages]][[ja:乾]] |- | {{ill|Dui|en}}[[category:new pages]][[ja:兌]] |- | {{ill|Gen|en}}[[category:new pages]][[ja:艮]] |- | {{ill|Li|en}}[[category:new pages]][[ja:離]] |}{{color]] '''Nine Stars''' ({{ill|Nine Stars|en}}[[category:new pages]][[ja:九星]], Kyūsei) is a form of [[folk belief]] originating from ancient [[China]], consisting of nine stars: '''First White''', '''Second Black''', '''Third Blue''', '''Fourth Green''', '''Fifth Yellow''', '''Sixth White''', '''Seventh Red''', '''Eighth White''', and '''Ninth Purple'''.
The term "Nine Stars" can refer to several systems, and the one described here is specifically referred to as the "Purple White Nine Stars" or "Seven Colored Stars."
== Origin == The Nine Stars system originates from the following {{ill|magic square|en}}[[category:new pages]][[ja:魔方陣]]:
{| class="wikitable" |- |Four||Nine||Two |- |Three||Five||Seven |- |Eight||One||Six |}
In this magic square, the sum of any row, column, or diagonal equals 15. It uses the numbers 1 through 9 exactly once in a 3×3 grid. This configuration, called the '''Later Heaven Arrangement''' ({{ill|Later Heaven Arrangement|en}}[[category:new pages]][[ja:後天定位盤]]), is the only one of its kind, excluding rotations and reflections. These numbers are paired with seven colors (white, black, blue, green, yellow, red, and purple), the {{ill|five elements|en}}[[category:new pages]][[ja:五行思想]] ({{ill|wood|en}}[[category:new pages]][[ja:木]], {{ill|fire|en}}[[category:new pages]][[ja:火]], {{ill|earth|en}}[[category:new pages]][[ja:土]], {{ill|metal|en}}[[category:new pages]][[ja:金]], and {{ill|water|en}}[[category:new pages]][[ja:水]]), the {{ill|ten heavenly stems|en}}[[category:new pages]][[ja:十干]], the {{ill|twelve earthly branches|en}}[[category:new pages]][[ja:十二支]], and the {{ill|eight trigrams|en}}[[category:new pages]][[ja:八卦]] of {{ill|I Ching|en}}[[category:new pages]][[ja:易経]]. When these numbers shift positions, interpretations are added to form the "Nine Stars."
According to legend, {{ill|Yu the Great|en}}[[category:new pages]][[ja:禹]], founder of the {{ill|Xia Dynasty|en}}[[category:new pages]][[ja:夏王朝]], conceived this magic square when he encountered a sacred turtle emerging from the {{ill|Luo River|en}}[[category:new pages]][[ja:洛水]]. This magic square is called the "Writing of the Luo" ({{ill|Luo Writing|en}}[[category:new pages]][[ja:洛書]]), one of the {{ill|River Chart and Luo Writing|en}}[[category:new pages]][[ja:河図洛書]].

{{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}} '''Son''' (巽) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Xun as Wind|ja|巽為風}}, consisting of Son below and Son above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Son symbolizes {{ill|wind|ja|風}} (also associated with {{ill|wood|ja|木}}), entry, {{ill|chickens|ja|ニワトリ}}, the thighs, the eldest daughter (a woman of {{ill|marriageable age|ja|結婚適齢期}}), {{ill|marriage proposals|ja|縁談}}, anything long, {{ill|blood vessels|ja|血管}}, {{ill|hair|ja|毛髪}}, {{ill|small intestine|ja|小腸}}, {{ill|large intestine|ja|大腸}}, {{ill|bronchi|ja|気管支}}, submersion, and the {{ill|respiratory system|ja|呼吸器}}. As a {{ill|direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Son is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛}}, the Metal element in {{ill|Wu Xing|ja|五行思想}}, and the {{ill|west|ja|西}} among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Direction == As a {{ill|direction|ja|方位}}, Son corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan (☵)|ja|坎}}, {{ill|Gen (☶)|ja|艮}}, {{ill|Zhen (☳)|ja|震}}, Son (巽), {{ill|Li (☲)|ja|離}}, {{ill|Kun (☷)|ja|坤}}, {{ill|Dui (☱)|ja|兌}}, and {{ill|Qian (☰)|ja|乾}}—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Chen (辰)|ja|辰}} (*tatsu*) and {{ill|Si (巳)|ja|巳}} (*mi*), Son is also read as *Tatsumi* (たつみ).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Son is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

{{Bagua}} '''Son''' (巽) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Xun as Wind|ja|巽為風}}, consisting of Son below and Son above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Son symbolizes {{ill|wind|ja|風}} (also associated with {{ill|wood|ja|木}}), entry, {{ill|chickens|ja|ニワトリ}}, the thighs, the eldest daughter (a woman of {{ill|marriageable age|ja|結婚適齢期}}), {{ill|marriage proposals|ja|縁談}}, anything long, {{ill|blood vessels|ja|血管}}, {{ill|hair|ja|毛髪}}, {{ill|small intestine|ja|小腸}}, {{ill|large intestine|ja|大腸}}, {{ill|bronchi|ja|気管支}}, submersion, and the {{ill|respiratory system|ja|呼吸器}}. As a {{ill|direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Son is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛}}, the Metal element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the {{ill|west|ja|西}} among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.

{{Bagua}} '''Son''' (巽) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Xun as Wind|ja|巽為風}}, consisting of Son below and Son above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Son symbolizes {{ill|wind|ja|風}} (also associated with {{ill|wood|ja|木}}), entry, {{ill|chickens|ja|ニワトリ}}, the thighs, the eldest daughter (a woman of {{ill|marriageable age|ja|結婚適齢期}}), {{ill|marriage proposals|ja|縁談}}, anything long, {{ill|blood vessels|ja|血管}}, {{ill|hair|ja|毛髪}}, {{ill|small intestine|ja|小腸}}, {{ill|large intestine|ja|大腸}}, {{ill|bronchi|ja|気管支}}, submersion, and the {{ill|respiratory system|ja|呼吸器}}. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Son is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛}}, the Metal element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the {{ill|west|ja|西}} among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Direction == As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, Son corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|lt=Kan (☵)}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|lt=Gen (☶)}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|lt=Zhen (☳)}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|lt=Xun (☴)}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|lt=Li (☲)}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|lt=Kun (☷)}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)}}, and {{ill|Qian|ja|乾|lt=Qian (☰)}}—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Chen (辰)|ja|辰}} (*tatsu*) and {{ill|Si (巳)|ja|巳}} (*mi*), Son is also read as *Tatsumi* (たつみ).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Son is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

{{Bagua}} '''Son''' (巽) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Xun as Wind|ja|巽為風}}, consisting of Son below and Son above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Son symbolizes {{ill|wind|ja|風}} (also associated with {{ill|wood|ja|木}}), entry, {{ill|chickens|ja|ニワトリ}}, the thighs, the eldest daughter (a woman of {{ill|marriageable age|ja|結婚適齢期}}), {{ill|marriage proposals|ja|縁談}}, anything long, {{ill|blood vessels|ja|血管}}, {{ill|hair|ja|毛髪}}, {{ill|small intestine|ja|小腸}}, {{ill|large intestine|ja|大腸}}, {{ill|bronchi|ja|気管支}}, submersion, and the {{ill|respiratory system|ja|呼吸器}}. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Son is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛}}, the Metal element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the {{ill|west|ja|西}} among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Direction == As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, Son corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|lt=Kan (☵)}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|lt=Gen (☶)}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|lt=Zhen (☳)}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|lt=Xun (☴)}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|lt=Li (☲)}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|lt=Kun (☷)}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)}}, and {{ill|Qian|ja|乾|lt=Qian (☰)}}—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Chen (辰)|ja|辰}} (*tatsu*) and {{ill|Si (巳)|ja|巳}} (*mi*), Son is also read as *Tatsumi* (たつみ).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Son is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

{{Bagua}} '''Son''' (巽) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Xun as Wind|ja|巽為風}}, consisting of Son below and Son above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Son symbolizes {{ill|wind|ja|風}} (also associated with {{ill|wood|ja|木}}), entry, {{ill|chickens|ja|ニワトリ}}, the thighs, the eldest daughter (a woman of {{ill|marriageable age|ja|結婚適齢期}}), {{ill|marriage proposals|ja|縁談}}, anything long, {{ill|blood vessels|ja|血管}}, {{ill|hair|ja|毛髪}}, {{ill|small intestine|ja|小腸}}, {{ill|large intestine|ja|大腸}}, {{ill|bronchi|ja|気管支}}, submersion, and the {{ill|respiratory system|ja|呼吸器}}. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Son is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛}}, the Metal element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the {{ill|west|ja|西}} among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Direction == As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, Son corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|lt=Kan (☵)}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|lt=Gen (☶)}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|lt=Zhen (☳)}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|lt=Xun (☴)}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|lt=Li (☲)}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|lt=Kun (☷)}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)}}, and {{ill|Qian|ja|乾|lt=Qian (☰)}}—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Chen (辰)|ja|辰}} (*tatsu*) and {{ill|Si (巳)|ja|巳}} (*mi*), Son is also read as *Tatsumi* (たつみ).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Son is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

{{Bagua}} '''Son''' (巽) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Xun as Wind|ja|巽為風}}, consisting of Son below and Son above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Son symbolizes {{ill|wind|ja|風}} (also associated with {{ill|wood|ja|木}}), entry, {{ill|chickens|ja|ニワトリ}}, the thighs, the eldest daughter (a woman of {{ill|marriageable age|ja|結婚適齢期}}), {{ill|marriage proposals|ja|縁談}}, anything long, {{ill|blood vessels|ja|血管}}, {{ill|hair|ja|毛髪}}, {{ill|small intestine|ja|小腸}}, {{ill|large intestine|ja|大腸}}, {{ill|bronchi|ja|気管支}}, submersion, and the {{ill|respiratory system|ja|呼吸器}}. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Son is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛}}, the Metal element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the {{ill|west|ja|西}} among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Direction == As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, Son corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|lt=Kan (☵)}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|lt=Gen (☶)}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|lt=Zhen (☳)}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|lt=Xun (☴)}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|lt=Li (☲)}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|lt=Kun (☷)}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)}}, and {{ill|Qian|ja|乾|lt=Qian (☰)}}—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Chen (辰)|ja|辰}} (*tatsu*) and {{ill|Si (巳)|ja|巳}} (*mi*), Son is also read as *Tatsumi* (たつみ).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Son is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

{{Bagua}} '''Son''' (巽) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Xun as Wind|ja|巽為風}}, consisting of Son below and Son above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Son symbolizes {{ill|wind|ja|風}} (also associated with {{ill|wood|ja|木}}), entry, {{ill|chickens|ja|ニワトリ}}, the thighs, the eldest daughter (a woman of {{ill|marriageable age|ja|結婚適齢期}}), {{ill|marriage proposals|ja|縁談}}, anything long, {{ill|blood vessels|ja|血管}}, {{ill|hair|ja|毛髪}}, {{ill|small intestine|ja|小腸}}, {{ill|large intestine|ja|大腸}}, {{ill|bronchi|ja|気管支}}, submersion, and the {{ill|respiratory system|ja|呼吸器}}. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Son is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛}}, the Metal element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the {{ill|west|ja|西}} among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Direction == As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, Son corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|lt=Kan (☵)}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|lt=Gen (☶)}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|lt=Zhen (☳)}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|lt=Xun (☴)}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|lt=Li (☲)}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|lt=Kun (☷)}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)}}, and {{ill|Qian|ja|乾|lt=Qian (☰)}}—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Chen (辰)|ja|辰}} (*tatsu*) and {{ill|Si (巳)|ja|巳}} (*mi*), Son is also read as *Tatsumi* (たつみ).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Son is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|lt=Kan (☵)}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|lt=Gen (☶)}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|lt=Zhen (☳)}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|lt=Xun (☴)}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|lt=Li (☲)}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|lt=Kun (☷)}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)}}, and {{ill|Qian|ja|乾|lt=Qian (☰)}}—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Chen (辰)|ja|辰}} (*tatsu*) and {{ill|Si (巳)|ja|巳}} (*mi*), Son is also read as *Tatsumi* (たつみ).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Son is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

{{Bagua}} '''Son''' (巽) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Xun as Wind|ja|巽為風}}, consisting of Son below and Son above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Son symbolizes {{ill|wind|ja|風}} (also associated with {{ill|wood|ja|木}}), entry, {{ill|chickens|ja|ニワトリ}}, the thighs, the eldest daughter (a woman of {{ill|marriageable age|ja|結婚適齢期}}), {{ill|marriage proposals|ja|縁談}}, anything long, {{ill|blood vessels|ja|血管}}, {{ill|hair|ja|毛髪}}, {{ill|small intestine|ja|小腸}}, {{ill|large intestine|ja|大腸}}, {{ill|bronchi|ja|気管支}}, submersion, and the {{ill|respiratory system|ja|呼吸器}}. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Son is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛}}, the Metal element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the {{ill|west|ja|西}} among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.

{{Bagua}} '''Son''' (巽) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Xun as Wind|ja|巽為風}}, consisting of Son below and Son above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Son symbolizes {{ill|wind|ja|風}} (also associated with {{ill|wood|ja|木}}), entry, {{ill|chickens|ja|ニワトリ}}, the thighs, the eldest daughter (a woman of {{ill|marriageable age|ja|結婚適齢期}}), {{ill|marriage proposals|ja|縁談}}, anything long, {{ill|blood vessels|ja|血管}}, {{ill|hair|ja|毛髪}}, {{ill|small intestine|ja|小腸}}, {{ill|large intestine|ja|大腸}}, {{ill|bronchi|ja|気管支}}, submersion, and the {{ill|respiratory system|ja|呼吸器}}. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Son is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛}}, the Metal element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the {{ill|west|ja|西}} among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Direction == As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, Son corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|lt=Kan (☵)}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|lt=Gen (☶)}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|lt=Zhen (☳)}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|lt=Xun (☴)}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|lt=Li (☲)}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|lt=Kun (☷)}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)}}, and {{ill|Qian|ja|乾|lt=Qian (☰)}}—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Chen (辰)|ja|辰}} (*tatsu*) and {{ill|Si (巳)|ja|巳}} (*mi*), Son is also read as *Tatsumi* (たつみ).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Son is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

{{Bagua}} '''Xun''' (巽) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Xun as Wind|ja|巽為風}}, consisting of Son below and Son above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Son symbolizes {{ill|wind|ja|風}} (also associated with {{ill|wood|ja|木}}), entry, {{ill|chickens|ja|ニワトリ}}, the thighs, the eldest daughter (a woman of {{ill|marriageable age|ja|結婚適齢期}}), {{ill|marriage proposals|ja|縁談}}, anything long, {{ill|blood vessels|ja|血管}}, {{ill|hair|ja|毛髪}}, {{ill|small intestine|ja|小腸}}, {{ill|large intestine|ja|大腸}}, {{ill|bronchi|ja|気管支}}, submersion, and the {{ill|respiratory system|ja|呼吸器}}. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Son is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛}}, the Metal element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the {{ill|west|ja|西}} among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Direction == As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, Son corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|lt=Kan (☵)}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|lt=Gen (☶)}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|lt=Zhen (☳)}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|lt=Xun (☴)}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|lt=Li (☲)}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|lt=Kun (☷)}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)}}, and {{ill|Qian|ja|乾|lt=Qian (☰)}}—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Chen (辰)|ja|辰}} (*tatsu*) and {{ill|Si (巳)|ja|巳}} (*mi*), Son is also read as *Tatsumi* (たつみ).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Son is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

{{Bagua}} '''Xun''' (巽) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Xun as Wind|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|lt=Xun為風}}, consisting of Son below and Son above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Son symbolizes {{ill|wind|ja|風}} (also associated with {{ill|wood|ja|木}}), entry, {{ill|chickens|ja|ニワトリ}}, the thighs, the eldest daughter (a woman of {{ill|marriageable age|ja|結婚適齢期}}), {{ill|marriage proposals|ja|縁談}}, anything long, {{ill|blood vessels|ja|血管}}, {{ill|hair|ja|毛髪}}, {{ill|small intestine|ja|小腸}}, {{ill|large intestine|ja|大腸}}, {{ill|bronchi|ja|気管支}}, submersion, and the {{ill|respiratory system|ja|呼吸器}}. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Son is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛}}, the Metal element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the {{ill|west|ja|西}} among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Direction == As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, Son corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kan (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gen (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|lt=Xun|lt=Xun (☴)}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li|lt=Li (☲)}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|1=Kun (Bagua)|lt=Kun|lt=Kun (☷)}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|1=Dui (Bagua)|lt=Dui|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)}}, and {{ill|Qian|ja|乾|1=Qian (Bagua)|lt=Qian|lt=Qian (☰)}}—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Chen (辰)|ja|辰}} (*tatsu*) and {{ill|Si (巳)|ja|巳}} (*mi*), Son is also read as *Tatsumi* (たつみ).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Son is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

{{Bagua}} '''Xun''' (巽) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Xun as Wind|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|lt=Xun為風}}, consisting of Son below and Son above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Son symbolizes {{ill|wind|ja|風}} (also associated with {{ill|wood|ja|木}}), entry, {{ill|chickens|ja|ニワトリ}}, the thighs, the eldest daughter (a woman of {{ill|marriageable age|ja|結婚適齢期}}), {{ill|marriage proposals|ja|縁談}}, anything long, {{ill|blood vessels|ja|血管}}, {{ill|hair|ja|毛髪}}, {{ill|small intestine|ja|小腸}}, {{ill|large intestine|ja|大腸}}, {{ill|bronchi|ja|気管支}}, submersion, and the {{ill|respiratory system|ja|呼吸器}}. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Son is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛}}, the Metal element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the {{ill|west|ja|西}} among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Direction == As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, Son corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kan (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gen (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|lt=Xun|lt=Xun (☴)}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li|lt=Li (☲)}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|1=Kun (Bagua)|lt=Kun|lt=Kun (☷)}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|1=Dui (Bagua)|lt=Dui|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)}}, and {{ill|Qian|ja|乾|1=Qian (Bagua)|lt=Qian|lt=Qian (☰)}}—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Chen (辰)|ja|辰}} (*tatsu*) and {{ill|Si (巳)|ja|巳}} (*mi*), Son is also read as *Tatsumi* (たつみ).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Son is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

{{Bagua}} '''Xun''' (巽) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Xun as Wind|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|lt=Xun為風}}, consisting of Son below and Son above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Son symbolizes {{ill|wind|ja|風}} (also associated with {{ill|wood|ja|木}}), entry, {{ill|chickens|ja|ニワトリ}}, the thighs, the eldest daughter (a woman of {{ill|marriageable age|ja|結婚適齢期}}), {{ill|marriage proposals|ja|縁談}}, anything long, {{ill|blood vessels|ja|血管}}, {{ill|hair|ja|毛髪}}, {{ill|small intestine|ja|小腸}}, {{ill|large intestine|ja|大腸}}, {{ill|bronchi|ja|気管支}}, submersion, and the {{ill|respiratory system|ja|呼吸器}}. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Son is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛}}, the Metal element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the {{ill|west|ja|西}} among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Direction == As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, Son corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kan (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gen (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|lt=Xun|lt=Xun (☴)}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li|lt=Li (☲)}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|1=Kun (Bagua)|lt=Kun|lt=Kun (☷)}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|1=Dui (Bagua)|lt=Dui|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)}}, and {{ill|Qian|ja|乾|1=Qian (Bagua)|lt=Qian|lt=Qian (☰)}}—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Chen (辰)|ja|辰}} (*tatsu*) and {{ill|Si (巳)|ja|巳}} (*mi*), Son is also read as *Tatsumi* (たつみ).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Son is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

{{Bagua}} '''Xun''' (巽) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Xun as Wind|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|lt=Xun為風}}, consisting of Son below and Son above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Son symbolizes {{ill|wind|ja|風}} (also associated with {{ill|wood|ja|木}}), entry, {{ill|chickens|ja|ニワトリ}}, the thighs, the eldest daughter (a woman of {{ill|marriageable age|ja|結婚適齢期}}), {{ill|marriage proposals|ja|縁談}}, anything long, {{ill|blood vessels|ja|血管}}, {{ill|hair|ja|毛髪}}, {{ill|small intestine|ja|小腸}}, {{ill|large intestine|ja|大腸}}, {{ill|bronchi|ja|気管支}}, submersion, and the {{ill|respiratory system|ja|呼吸器}}. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Son is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛}}, the Metal element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the {{ill|west|ja|西}} among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Direction == As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, Son corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kan (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gen (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|lt=Xun|lt=Xun (☴)}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li|lt=Li (☲)}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|1=Kun (Bagua)|lt=Kun|lt=Kun (☷)}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|1=Dui (Bagua)|lt=Dui|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)}}, and {{ill|Qian|ja|乾|1=Qian (Bagua)|lt=Qian|lt=Qian (☰)}}—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Chen (辰)|ja|辰}} (*tatsu*) and {{ill|Si (巳)|ja|巳}} (*mi*), Son is also read as *Tatsumi* (たつみ).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Son is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

{{Bagua}} '''Xun''' (巽) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Xun as Wind|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|lt=Xun為風}}, consisting of Son below and Son above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Son symbolizes {{ill|wind|ja|風}} (also associated with {{ill|wood|ja|木}}), entry, {{ill|chickens|ja|ニワトリ}}, the thighs, the eldest daughter (a woman of {{ill|marriageable age|ja|結婚適齢期}}), {{ill|marriage proposals|ja|縁談}}, anything long, {{ill|blood vessels|ja|血管}}, {{ill|hair|ja|毛髪}}, {{ill|small intestine|ja|小腸}}, {{ill|large intestine|ja|大腸}}, {{ill|bronchi|ja|気管支}}, submersion, and the {{ill|respiratory system|ja|呼吸器}}. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Son is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛}}, the Metal element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the {{ill|west|ja|西}} among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Direction == As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, Son corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kan (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gen (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|lt=Xun|lt=Xun (☴)}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li|lt=Li (☲)}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|1=Kun (Bagua)|lt=Kun|lt=Kun (☷)}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|1=Dui (Bagua)|lt=Dui|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)}}, and {{ill|Qian|ja|乾|1=Qian (Bagua)|lt=Qian|lt=Qian (☰)}}—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Chen (辰)|ja|辰}} (*tatsu*) and {{ill|Si (巳)|ja|巳}} (*mi*), Son is also read as *Tatsumi* (たつみ).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Son is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Son is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛}}, the Metal element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the {{ill|west|ja|西}} among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Direction == As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, Son corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kan (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gen (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|lt=Xun|lt=Xun (☴)}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li|lt=Li (☲)}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|1=Kun (Bagua)|lt=Kun|lt=Kun (☷)}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|1=Dui (Bagua)|lt=Dui|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)}}, and {{ill|Qian|ja|乾|1=Qian (Bagua)|lt=Qian|lt=Qian (☰)}}—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Chen (辰)|ja|辰}} (*tatsu*) and {{ill|Si (巳)|ja|巳}} (*mi*), Son is also read as *Tatsumi* (たつみ).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Son is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

{{Bagua}} '''Xun''' (巽) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Xun as Wind|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|lt=Xun為風}}, consisting of Son below and Son above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Son symbolizes {{ill|wind|ja|風}} (also associated with {{ill|wood|ja|木}}), entry, {{ill|chickens|ja|ニワトリ}}, the thighs, the eldest daughter (a woman of {{ill|marriageable age|ja|結婚適齢期}}), {{ill|marriage proposals|ja|縁談}}, anything long, {{ill|blood vessels|ja|血管}}, {{ill|hair|ja|毛髪}}, {{ill|small intestine|ja|小腸}}, {{ill|large intestine|ja|大腸}}, {{ill|bronchi|ja|気管支}}, submersion, and the {{ill|respiratory system|ja|呼吸器}}. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Son is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛}}, the Metal element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the {{ill|west|ja|西}} among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Direction == As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, Son corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kan (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gen (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|lt=Xun|lt=Xun (☴)}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li|lt=Li (☲)}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|1=Kun (Bagua)|lt=Kun|lt=Kun (☷)}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|1=Dui (Bagua)|lt=Dui|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)}}, and {{ill|Qian|ja|乾|1=Qian (Bagua)|lt=Qian|lt=Qian (☰)}}—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Chen (辰)|ja|辰}} (*tatsu*) and {{ill|Si (巳)|ja|巳}} (*mi*), Son is also read as *Tatsumi* (たつみ).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Son is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

{{Bagua}} '''Xun''' (巽) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Xun as Wind|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|lt=Xun為風}}, consisting of Son below and Son above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Son symbolizes {{ill|wind|ja|風}} (also associated with {{ill|wood|ja|木}}), entry, {{ill|chickens|ja|ニワトリ}}, the thighs, the eldest daughter (a woman of {{ill|marriageable age|ja|結婚適齢期}}), {{ill|marriage proposals|ja|縁談}}, anything long, {{ill|blood vessels|ja|血管}}, {{ill|hair|ja|毛髪}}, {{ill|small intestine|ja|小腸}}, {{ill|large intestine|ja|大腸}}, {{ill|bronchi|ja|気管支}}, submersion, and the {{ill|respiratory system|ja|呼吸器}}. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Son is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛}}, the Metal element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the {{ill|west|ja|西}} among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Direction == As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, Son corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kan (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gen (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|lt=Xun|lt=Xun (☴)}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li|lt=Li (☲)}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|1=Kun (Bagua)|lt=Kun|lt=Kun (☷)}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|1=Dui (Bagua)|lt=Dui|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)}}, and {{ill|Qian|ja|乾|1=Qian (Bagua)|lt=Qian|lt=Qian (☰)}}—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Chen (辰)|ja|辰}} (*tatsu*) and {{ill|Si (巳)|ja|巳}} (*mi*), Son is also read as *Tatsumi* (たつみ).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Son is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Xun as Wind|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|lt=Xun為風}}, consisting of Son below and Son above.

In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Son is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛}}, the Metal element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the {{ill|west|ja|西}} among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.

{{Bagua}} '''Xun''' (巽) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Xun as Wind|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|lt=Xun為風}}, consisting of Son below and Son above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Son symbolizes {{ill|wind|ja|風}} (also associated with {{ill|wood|ja|木}}), entry, {{ill|chickens|ja|ニワトリ}}, the thighs, the eldest daughter (a woman of {{ill|marriageable age|ja|結婚適齢期}}), {{ill|marriage proposals|ja|縁談}}, anything long, {{ill|blood vessels|ja|血管}}, {{ill|hair|ja|毛髪}}, {{ill|small intestine|ja|小腸}}, {{ill|large intestine|ja|大腸}}, {{ill|bronchi|ja|気管支}}, submersion, and the {{ill|respiratory system|ja|呼吸器}}. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Son is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛}}, the Metal element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the {{ill|west|ja|西}} among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Direction == As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, Son corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kan (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gen (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|lt=Xun|lt=Xun (☴)}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li|lt=Li (☲)}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|1=Kun (Bagua)|lt=Kun|lt=Kun (☷)}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|1=Dui (Bagua)|lt=Dui|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)}}, and {{ill|Qian|ja|乾|1=Qian (Bagua)|lt=Qian|lt=Qian (☰)}}—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Chen (辰)|ja|辰}} (*tatsu*) and {{ill|Si (巳)|ja|巳}} (*mi*), Son is also read as *Tatsumi* (たつみ).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Son is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

{{Bagua}} '''Xun''' (巽) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Xun as Wind|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|lt=Xun為風}}, consisting of Son below and Son above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Son symbolizes {{ill|wind|ja|風}} (also associated with {{ill|wood|ja|木}}), entry, {{ill|chickens|ja|ニワトリ}}, the thighs, the eldest daughter (a woman of {{ill|marriageable age|ja|結婚適齢期}}), {{ill|marriage proposals|ja|縁談}}, anything long, {{ill|blood vessels|ja|血管}}, {{ill|hair|ja|毛髪}}, {{ill|small intestine|ja|小腸}}, {{ill|large intestine|ja|大腸}}, {{ill|bronchi|ja|気管支}}, submersion, and the {{ill|respiratory system|ja|呼吸器}}. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Son is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛}}, the Metal element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the {{ill|west|ja|西}} among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Direction == As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, Son corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kan (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gen (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|lt=Xun|lt=Xun (☴)}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li|lt=Li (☲)}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|1=Kun (Bagua)|lt=Kun|lt=Kun (☷)}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|1=Dui (Bagua)|lt=Dui|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)}}, and {{ill|Qian|ja|乾|1=Qian (Bagua)|lt=Qian|lt=Qian (☰)}}—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Chen (辰)|ja|辰}} (*tatsu*) and {{ill|Si (巳)|ja|巳}} (*mi*), Son is also read as *Tatsumi* (たつみ).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Son is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

{{Bagua}} '''Xun''' (巽) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Xun as Wind|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|lt=Xun為風}}, consisting of Son below and Son above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Son symbolizes {{ill|wind|ja|風}} (also associated with {{ill|wood|ja|木}}), entry, {{ill|chickens|ja|ニワトリ}}, the thighs, the eldest daughter (a woman of {{ill|marriageable age|ja|結婚適齢期}}), {{ill|marriage proposals|ja|縁談}}, anything long, {{ill|blood vessels|ja|血管}}, {{ill|hair|ja|毛髪}}, {{ill|small intestine|ja|小腸}}, {{ill|large intestine|ja|大腸}}, {{ill|bronchi|ja|気管支}}, submersion, and the {{ill|respiratory system|ja|呼吸器}}. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Son is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛}}, the Metal element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the {{ill|west|ja|西}} among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Direction == As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, Son corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kan (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gen (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|lt=Xun|lt=Xun (☴)}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li|lt=Li (☲)}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|1=Kun (Bagua)|lt=Kun|lt=Kun (☷)}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|1=Dui (Bagua)|lt=Dui|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)}}, and {{ill|Qian|ja|乾|1=Qian (Bagua)|lt=Qian|lt=Qian (☰)}}—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Chen (辰)|ja|辰}} (*tatsu*) and {{ill|Si (巳)|ja|巳}} (*mi*), Son is also read as *Tatsumi* (たつみ).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Son is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

{{Bagua}} '''Xun''' (巽) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Xun as Wind|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|lt=Xun為風}}, consisting of Son below and Son above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Son symbolizes {{ill|wind|ja|風}} (also associated with {{ill|wood|ja|木}}), entry, {{ill|chickens|ja|ニワトリ}}, the thighs, the eldest daughter (a woman of {{ill|marriageable age|ja|結婚適齢期}}), {{ill|marriage proposals|ja|縁談}}, anything long, {{ill|blood vessels|ja|血管}}, {{ill|hair|ja|毛髪}}, {{ill|small intestine|ja|小腸}}, {{ill|large intestine|ja|大腸}}, {{ill|bronchi|ja|気管支}}, submersion, and the {{ill|respiratory system|ja|呼吸器}}. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Son is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛}}, the Metal element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the {{ill|west|ja|西}} among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Direction == As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, Son corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kan (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gen (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|lt=Xun|lt=Xun (☴)}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li|lt=Li (☲)}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|1=Kun (Bagua)|lt=Kun|lt=Kun (☷)}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|1=Dui (Bagua)|lt=Dui|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)}}, and {{ill|Qian|ja|乾|1=Qian (Bagua)|lt=Qian|lt=Qian (☰)}}—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Chen (辰)|ja|辰}} (*tatsu*) and {{ill|Si (巳)|ja|巳}} (*mi*), Son is also read as *Tatsumi* (たつみ).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Son is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛}}, the Metal element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the {{ill|west|ja|西}} among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Direction == As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kan (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gen (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|lt=Xun|lt=Xun (☴)}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li|lt=Li (☲)}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|1=Kun (Bagua)|lt=Kun|lt=Kun (☷)}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|1=Dui (Bagua)|lt=Dui|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)}}, and {{ill|Qian|ja|乾|1=Qian (Bagua)|lt=Qian|lt=Qian (☰)}}—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Chen (辰)|ja|辰}} (*tatsu*) and {{ill|Si (巳)|ja|巳}} (*mi*), Xun is also read as *Tatsumi* (たつみ).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

{{Bagua}} '''Xun''' (巽) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|lt=巽為風}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Xun symbolizes {{ill|wind|ja|風}} (also associated with {{ill|wood|ja|木}}), entry, {{ill|chickens|ja|ニワトリ}}, the thighs, the eldest daughter (a woman of {{ill|marriageable age|ja|結婚適齢期}}), {{ill|marriage proposals|ja|縁談}}, anything long, {{ill|blood vessels|ja|血管}}, {{ill|hair|ja|毛髪}}, {{ill|small intestine|ja|小腸}}, {{ill|large intestine|ja|大腸}}, {{ill|bronchi|ja|気管支}}, submersion, and the {{ill|respiratory system|ja|呼吸器}}. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)}}, the Metal element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the {{ill|west|ja|西}} among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Direction == As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kan (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gen (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|lt=Xun|lt=Xun (☴)}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li|lt=Li (☲)}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|1=Kun (Bagua)|lt=Kun|lt=Kun (☷)}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|1=Dui (Bagua)|lt=Dui|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)}}, and {{ill|Qian|ja|乾|1=Qian (Bagua)|lt=Qian|lt=Qian (☰)}}—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Chen (辰)|ja|辰}} (*tatsu*) and {{ill|Si (巳)|ja|巳}} (*mi*), Xun is also read as *Tatsumi* (たつみ).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

{{Bagua}} '''Xun''' (巽) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|lt=巽為風}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Xun symbolizes {{ill|wind|ja|風}} (also associated with {{ill|wood|ja|木}}), entry, {{ill|chickens|ja|ニワトリ}}, the thighs, the eldest daughter (a woman of {{ill|marriageable age|ja|結婚適齢期}}), {{ill|marriage proposals|ja|縁談}}, anything long, {{ill|blood vessels|ja|血管}}, {{ill|hair|ja|毛髪}}, {{ill|small intestine|ja|小腸}}, {{ill|large intestine|ja|大腸}}, {{ill|bronchi|ja|気管支}}, submersion, and the {{ill|respiratory system|ja|呼吸器}}. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)}}, the Metal element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the {{ill|west|ja|西}} among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Direction == As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kan (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gen (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|lt=Xun|lt=Xun (☴)}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li|lt=Li (☲)}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|1=Kun (Bagua)|lt=Kun|lt=Kun (☷)}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|1=Dui (Bagua)|lt=Dui|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)}}, and {{ill|Qian|ja|乾|1=Qian (Bagua)|lt=Qian|lt=Qian (☰)}}—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Chen (辰)|ja|辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)}} (*tatsu*) and {{ill|Si (巳)|ja|巳}} (*mi*), Xun is also read as *Tatsumi* (たつみ).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

{{Bagua}} '''Xun''' (巽) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|lt=巽為風}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Xun symbolizes {{ill|wind|ja|風}} (also associated with {{ill|wood|ja|木}}), entry, {{ill|chickens|ja|ニワトリ}}, the thighs, the eldest daughter (a woman of {{ill|marriageable age|ja|結婚適齢期}}), {{ill|marriage proposals|ja|縁談}}, anything long, {{ill|blood vessels|ja|血管}}, {{ill|hair|ja|毛髪}}, {{ill|small intestine|ja|小腸}}, {{ill|large intestine|ja|大腸}}, {{ill|bronchi|ja|気管支}}, submersion, and the {{ill|respiratory system|ja|呼吸器}}. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)}}, the Metal element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the {{ill|west|ja|西}} among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Direction == As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kan (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gen (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|lt=Xun|lt=Xun (☴)}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li|lt=Li (☲)}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|1=Kun (Bagua)|lt=Kun|lt=Kun (☷)}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|1=Dui (Bagua)|lt=Dui|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)}}, and {{ill|Qian|ja|乾|1=Qian (Bagua)|lt=Qian|lt=Qian (☰)}}—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Chen (辰)|ja|辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)}} (*tatsu*) and {{ill|Si (巳)|ja|巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)}} (*mi*), Xun is also read as *Tatsumi* (たつみ).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

{{Bagua}} '''Xun''' (巽) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|lt=巽為風}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Xun symbolizes {{ill|wind|ja|風}} (also associated with {{ill|wood|ja|木}}), entry, {{ill|chickens|ja|ニワトリ}}, the thighs, the eldest daughter (a woman of {{ill|marriageable age|ja|結婚適齢期}}), {{ill|marriage proposals|ja|縁談}}, anything long, {{ill|blood vessels|ja|血管}}, {{ill|hair|ja|毛髪}}, {{ill|small intestine|ja|小腸}}, {{ill|large intestine|ja|大腸}}, {{ill|bronchi|ja|気管支}}, submersion, and the {{ill|respiratory system|ja|呼吸器}}. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)}}, the Metal element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the {{ill|west|ja|西}} among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Direction == As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kan (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gen (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|lt=Xun|lt=Xun (☴)}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li|lt=Li (☲)}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|1=Kun (Bagua)|lt=Kun|lt=Kun (☷)}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|1=Dui (Bagua)|lt=Dui|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)}}, and {{ill|Qian|ja|乾|1=Qian (Bagua)|lt=Qian|lt=Qian (☰)}}—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Chen (辰)|ja|辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)}} (*tatsu*) and {{ill|Si (巳)|ja|巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)}} (*mi*), Xun is also read as *Tatsumi* (たつみ).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

{{Bagua}} '''Xun''' (巽) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|lt=巽為風}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Xun symbolizes {{ill|wind|ja|風}} (also associated with {{ill|wood|ja|木}}), entry, {{ill|chickens|ja|ニワトリ}}, the thighs, the eldest daughter (a woman of {{ill|marriageable age|ja|結婚適齢期}}), {{ill|marriage proposals|ja|縁談}}, anything long, {{ill|blood vessels|ja|血管}}, {{ill|hair|ja|毛髪}}, {{ill|small intestine|ja|小腸}}, {{ill|large intestine|ja|大腸}}, {{ill|bronchi|ja|気管支}}, submersion, and the {{ill|respiratory system|ja|呼吸器}}. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)}}, the Metal element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the {{ill|west|ja|西}} among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Direction == As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kan (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gen (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|lt=Xun|lt=Xun (☴)}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li|lt=Li (☲)}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|1=Kun (Bagua)|lt=Kun|lt=Kun (☷)}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|1=Dui (Bagua)|lt=Dui|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)}}, and {{ill|Qian|ja|乾|1=Qian (Bagua)|lt=Qian|lt=Qian (☰)}}—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Chen (辰)|ja|辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)}} (*tatsu*) and {{ill|Si (巳)|ja|巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)}} (*mi*), Xun is also read as *Tatsumi* (たつみ).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

{{Bagua}} '''Xun''' (巽) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|lt=巽為風}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Xun symbolizes {{ill|wind|ja|風}} (also associated with {{ill|wood|ja|木}}), entry, {{ill|chickens|ja|ニワトリ}}, the thighs, the eldest daughter (a woman of {{ill|marriageable age|ja|結婚適齢期}}), {{ill|marriage proposals|ja|縁談}}, anything long, {{ill|blood vessels|ja|血管}}, {{ill|hair|ja|毛髪}}, {{ill|small intestine|ja|小腸}}, {{ill|large intestine|ja|大腸}}, {{ill|bronchi|ja|気管支}}, submersion, and the {{ill|respiratory system|ja|呼吸器}}. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)}}, the Metal element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the {{ill|west|ja|西}} among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Direction == As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kan (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gen (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|lt=Xun|lt=Xun (☴)}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li|lt=Li (☲)}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|1=Kun (Bagua)|lt=Kun|lt=Kun (☷)}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|1=Dui (Bagua)|lt=Dui|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)}}, and {{ill|Qian|ja|乾|1=Qian (Bagua)|lt=Qian|lt=Qian (☰)}}—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Chen (辰)|ja|辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)}} (*tatsu*) and {{ill|Si (巳)|ja|巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)}} (*mi*), Xun is also read as *Tatsumi* (たつみ).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

{{Bagua}} '''Xun''' (巽) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|lt=巽為風}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Xun symbolizes {{ill|wind|ja|風}} (also associated with {{ill|wood|ja|木}}), entry, {{ill|chickens|ja|ニワトリ}}, the thighs, the eldest daughter (a woman of {{ill|marriageable age|ja|結婚適齢期}}), {{ill|marriage proposals|ja|縁談}}, anything long, {{ill|blood vessels|ja|血管}}, {{ill|hair|ja|毛髪}}, {{ill|small intestine|ja|小腸}}, {{ill|large intestine|ja|大腸}}, {{ill|bronchi|ja|気管支}}, submersion, and the {{ill|respiratory system|ja|呼吸器}}. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)}}, the Metal element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the {{ill|west|ja|西}} among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Direction == As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kan (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gen (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|lt=Xun|lt=Xun (☴)}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li|lt=Li (☲)}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|1=Kun (Bagua)|lt=Kun|lt=Kun (☷)}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|1=Dui (Bagua)|lt=Dui|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)}}, and {{ill|Qian|ja|乾|1=Qian (Bagua)|lt=Qian|lt=Qian (☰)}}—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Chen (辰)|ja|辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)}} (*tatsu*) and {{ill|Si (巳)|ja|巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)}} (*mi*), Xun is also read as *Tatsumi* (たつみ).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.
