{{Bagua}} '''Xun''' (巽) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|lt=巽為風}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Xun symbolizes {{ill|wind|ja|風}} (also associated with {{ill|wood|ja|木}}), entry, {{ill|chickens|ja|ニワトリ}}, the thighs, the eldest daughter (a woman of {{ill|marriageable age|ja|結婚適齢期}}), {{ill|marriage proposals|ja|縁談}}, anything long, {{ill|blood vessels|ja|血管}}, {{ill|hair|ja|毛髪}}, {{ill|small intestine|ja|小腸}}, {{ill|large intestine|ja|大腸}}, {{ill|bronchi|ja|気管支}}, submersion, and the {{ill|respiratory system|ja|呼吸器}}. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)}}, the Metal element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the {{ill|west|ja|西}} among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Direction == As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kan (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gen (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|lt=Xun|lt=Xun (☴)}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li|lt=Li (☲)}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|1=Kun (Bagua)|lt=Kun|lt=Kun (☷)}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|1=Dui (Bagua)|lt=Dui|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)}}, and {{ill|Qian|ja|乾|1=Qian (Bagua)|lt=Qian|lt=Qian (☰)}}—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Chen (辰)|ja|辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)}} (*tatsu*) and {{ill|Si (巳)|ja|巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)}} (*mi*), Xun is also read as *Tatsumi* (たつみ).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|lt=巽為風}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Xun symbolizes {{ill|wind|ja|風}} (also associated with {{ill|wood|ja|木}}), entry, {{ill|chickens|ja|ニワトリ}}, the thighs, the eldest daughter (a woman of {{ill|marriageable age|ja|結婚適齢期}}), {{ill|marriage proposals|ja|縁談}}, anything long, {{ill|blood vessels|ja|血管}}, {{ill|hair|ja|毛髪}}, {{ill|small intestine|ja|小腸}}, {{ill|large intestine|ja|大腸}}, {{ill|bronchi|ja|気管支}}, submersion, and the {{ill|respiratory system|ja|呼吸器}}. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)}}, the Metal element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the {{ill|west|ja|西}} among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Direction == As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kan (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gen (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|lt=Xun|lt=Xun (☴)}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li|lt=Li (☲)}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|1=Kun (Bagua)|lt=Kun|lt=Kun (☷)}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|1=Dui (Bagua)|lt=Dui|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)}}, and {{ill|Qian|ja|乾|1=Qian (Bagua)|lt=Qian|lt=Qian (☰)}}—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Chen (辰)|ja|辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)}} (*tatsu*) and {{ill|Si (巳)|ja|巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)}} (*mi*), Xun is also read as *Tatsumi* (たつみ).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

{{Bagua}} '''Xun''' (巽) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|lt=巽為風}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Xun symbolizes {{ill|wind|ja|風}} (also associated with {{ill|wood|ja|木}}), entry, {{ill|chickens|ja|ニワトリ}}, the thighs, the eldest daughter (a woman of {{ill|marriageable age|ja|結婚適齢期}}), {{ill|marriage proposals|ja|縁談}}, anything long, {{ill|blood vessels|ja|血管}}, {{ill|hair|ja|毛髪}}, {{ill|small intestine|ja|小腸}}, {{ill|large intestine|ja|大腸}}, {{ill|bronchi|ja|気管支}}, submersion, and the {{ill|respiratory system|ja|呼吸器}}. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)}}, the Metal element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the {{ill|west|ja|西}} among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Direction == As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}. Because it lies between {{ill|Chen (辰)|ja|辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)}} (*tatsu*) and {{ill|Si (巳)|ja|巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)}} (*mi*), Xun is also read as *Tatsumi* (たつみ).

{{Bagua}} '''Xun''' (巽) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|lt=巽為風}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Xun symbolizes {{ill|wind|ja|風}} (also associated with {{ill|wood|ja|木}}), entry, {{ill|chickens|ja|ニワトリ}}, the thighs, the eldest daughter (a woman of {{ill|marriageable age|ja|結婚適齢期}}), {{ill|marriage proposals|ja|縁談}}, anything long, {{ill|blood vessels|ja|血管}}, {{ill|hair|ja|毛髪}}, {{ill|small intestine|ja|小腸}}, {{ill|large intestine|ja|大腸}}, {{ill|bronchi|ja|気管支}}, submersion, and the {{ill|respiratory system|ja|呼吸器}}. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)}}, the Metal element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the {{ill|west|ja|西}} among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Direction == As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kan (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gen (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|lt=Xun|lt=Xun (☴)}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li|lt=Li (☲)}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|1=Kun (Bagua)|lt=Kun|lt=Kun (☷)}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|1=Dui (Bagua)|lt=Dui|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)}}, and {{ill|Qian|ja|乾|1=Qian (Bagua)|lt=Qian|lt=Qian (☰)}}—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Chen (辰)|ja|辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)}} (*tatsu*) and {{ill|Si (巳)|ja|巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)}} (*mi*), Xun is also read as *Tatsumi* (たつみ).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

{{Bagua}} '''Xun''' (巽) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|lt=巽為風}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Xun symbolizes {{ill|wind|ja|風}} (also associated with {{ill|wood|ja|木}}), entry, {{ill|chickens|ja|ニワトリ}}, the thighs, the eldest daughter (a woman of {{ill|marriageable age|ja|結婚適齢期}}), {{ill|marriage proposals|ja|縁談}}, anything long, {{ill|blood vessels|ja|血管}}, {{ill|hair|ja|毛髪}}, {{ill|small intestine|ja|小腸}}, {{ill|large intestine|ja|大腸}}, {{ill|bronchi|ja|気管支}}, submersion, and the {{ill|respiratory system|ja|呼吸器}}. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)}}, the Metal element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the {{ill|west|ja|西}} among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Direction == As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kan (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gen (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|lt=Xun|lt=Xun (☴)}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li|lt=Li (☲)}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|1=Kun (Bagua)|lt=Kun|lt=Kun (☷)}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|1=Dui (Bagua)|lt=Dui|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)}}, and {{ill|Qian|ja|乾|1=Qian (Bagua)|lt=Qian|lt=Qian (☰)}}—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Chen (辰)|ja|辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)}} (*tatsu*) and {{ill|Si (巳)|ja|巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)}} (*mi*), Xun is also read as *Tatsumi* (たつみ).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

{{Bagua}} '''Xun''' (巽) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|ja|八卦}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Sixty-Four Hexagrams|ja|六十四卦}}, known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|lt=巽為風}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Xun symbolizes {{ill|wind|ja|風}} (also associated with {{ill|wood|ja|木}}), entry, {{ill|chickens|ja|ニワトリ}}, the thighs, the eldest daughter (a woman of {{ill|marriageable age|ja|結婚適齢期}}), {{ill|marriage proposals|ja|縁談}}, anything long, {{ill|blood vessels|ja|血管}}, {{ill|hair|ja|毛髪}}, {{ill|small intestine|ja|小腸}}, {{ill|large intestine|ja|大腸}}, {{ill|bronchi|ja|気管支}}, submersion, and the {{ill|respiratory system|ja|呼吸器}}. As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)}}, the Metal element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|lt=Wuxing|ja|五行思想}}, and the {{ill|west|ja|西}} among the {{ill|Five Directions|ja|五方}}.
== Direction == As a {{ill|cardinal direction|ja|方位}}, Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|ja|十二支}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kan (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gen (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|lt=Xun|lt=Xun (☴)}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|lt=Li|lt=Li (☲)}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|1=Kun (Bagua)|lt=Kun|lt=Kun (☷)}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|1=Dui (Bagua)|lt=Dui|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)}}, and {{ill|Qian|ja|乾|1=Qian (Bagua)|lt=Qian|lt=Qian (☰)}}—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Chen (辰)|ja|辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)}} (*tatsu*) and {{ill|Si (巳)|ja|巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)}} (*mi*), Xun is also read as *Tatsumi* (たつみ).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

{{八卦}} '''巽'''（そん）は[[八卦]]の一つ。卦の形は{{resize|125%|'''☴'''}}であり、初[[爻]]は[[陰]]、第2爻・第3爻は陽で構成される。または[[六十四卦]]の一つであり、[[周易下経三十四卦の一覧#巽|巽為風]]。巽下巽上で構成される。
== 卦象 == [[風]]（[[木]]）・入・[[ニワトリ|鶏]]・股・長女（[[結婚適齢期]]の女性）・[[縁談]]・長いもの一切・[[血管]]・[[毛髪]]・[[小腸]]・[[大腸]]・[[気管支]]・伏入・呼吸器などを象徴する。[[方位]]としては[[東南]]（[[地支]]の[[辰]][[巳]]間）を示す。
[[納甲]]では[[辛]]、[[五行思想|五行]]の[[金]]、[[五方]]の[[西]]が当てられる。
== 方角 == [[方位|方角]]としては東南の方角になる。全方位（東西南北）を十二支で12等分した場合、北東、東南、南西、西北が表現できないため、これと別に北から時計回りに坎（かん）、艮（ごん）、震（しん）、巽（そん）、離（り）、坤（こん）、兌（だ）、乾（けん）の八卦を使って方角を表現した<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」国立国会図書館 2021年12月16日閲覧</ref>。[[辰]]（たつ）と[[巳]]（み）の間であることから巽は「たつみ」とも読まれる。
== 先天図 == 伏羲先天八卦における次序は五であり、方位は四隅卦の一つで[[西南]]に配される。[[陰陽]]消息は一陰が生じたところである。
== 脚注 == {{Reflist}}
== 関連項目 ==
* [[辰巳]] *[[巽町]] - [[巽北]]、[[巽中]]、[[巽西]]、[[巽東]]、[[巽南]]
{{DEFAULTSORT:そん}} [[Category:易]]

{{Bagua|qq=}} '''Xun''' (巽) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|lt=巽為風|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Xun symbolizes [[:en:Wind|wind]] (also associated with {{ill|wood|ja|Wood (木)|1=Wood (wuxing)|1=Wood (wuxing)|lt=Wood (木)|2=uk|3=Дерево (елемент)|4=id|5=Kayu (Wu Xing)|6=ms|7=Kayu (Wu Xing)|8=bcl|9=Kahoy (wuxing)|10=ca|11=Fusta (wuxing)|12=it|13=Legno (elemento)|14=es|15=Madera (Wu Xing)|16=nl|17=Hout (element)|18=vi|19=Mộc (Ngũ hành)|20=tr|21=Tahta (klasik element)|22=ta|23=மரம் (சீன மெய்யியல்)|2=it|3=Legno (elemento)|4=es|5=Madera (Wu Xing)|6=tr|7=Tahta (klasik element)|1=Wood (wuxing)|lt=Wood (木)|lt=Wood (木)|2=uk|3=Дерево (елемент)|4=id|5=Kayu (Wu Xing)|6=ms|7=Kayu (Wu Xing)|8=bcl|9=Kahoy (wuxing)|10=ca|11=Fusta (wuxing)|12=it|13=Legno (elemento)|14=es|15=Madera (Wu Xing)|16=nl|17=Hout (element)|18=vi|19=Mộc (Ngũ hành)|20=tr|21=Tahta (klasik element)|22=ta|23=மரம் (சீன மெய்யியல்)|2=it|3=Legno (elemento)|4=es|5=Madera (Wu Xing)|6=tr|7=Tahta (klasik element)|1=Wood (wuxing)|1=Wood (wuxing)|lt=Wood (木)|2=uk|3=Дерево (елемент)|4=id|5=Kayu (Wu element)|22=ta|23=மரம் (சீன மெய்யியல்)|2=it|3=Legno (elemento)|4=es|5=Madera (Wu Xing)|6=tr|7=Tahta (klasik element)|1=Wood (wuxing)|lt=Wood (木)|lt=Wood (木)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/wood|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/wood|13=User:Immanuelle/Wood (wuxing)|1=Wood (wuxing)|lt=Wood (木)|2=uk|3=Дерево (елемент)|4=id|5=Kayu (Wu Xing)|6=ms|7=Kayu (Wu Xing)|8=bcl|9=Kahoy (wuxing)|10=ca|11=Fusta (wuxing)|12=it|13=Legno (elemento)|14=es|15=Madera (Wu Xing)|16=nl|17=Hout (element)|18=vi|19=Mộc (Ngũ hành)|20=tr|21=Tahta (klasik element)|22=ta|23=மரம் (சீன மெய்யியல்)|2=it|3=Legno (elemento)|4=es|5=Madera (Wu Xing)|6=tr|7=Tahta (klasik element)|1=Wood (wuxing)|lt=Wood (木)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}), entry, [[:en:Chicken|chickens]], the thighs, the eldest daughter (a woman of {{ill|marriageable age|ja|結婚適齢期|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/marriageable age|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/marriageable age|qq=}}), {{ill|marriage proposals|ja|縁談|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/marriage proposals|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/marriage proposals|qq=}}, anything long, [[:en:Blood vessel|blood vessels]], {{ill|hair|ja|毛髪|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/hair|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/hair|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 頭髪}}, [[:en:Small intestine|small intestine]], [[:en:Large intestine|large intestine]], [[:en:Bronchus|bronchi]], submersion, and the [[:en:Respiratory system|respiratory system]]. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰|1=Dragon (Zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)|2=ja|3=辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (Zodiac)|qq=}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳|1=Snake (Zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|2=ja|3=巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (Zodiac)|qq=}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=}}, the Metal element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:West|west]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kan (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kan (坎)|1=Kan (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

{{Bagua|qq=}} '''Xun''' (巽) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|lt=巽為風|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Xun symbolizes [[:en:Wind|wind]] (also associated with {{ill|wood|ja|Wood (木)|1=Wood (wuxing)|1=Wood (wuxing)|lt=Wood (木)|2=uk|3=Дерево (елемент)|4=id|5=Kayu (Wu [[:en:Chicken|chickens]], the thighs, the eldest daughter (a woman of {{ill|marriageable age|ja|結婚適齢期|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/marriageable age|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/marriageable age|qq=}}), {{ill|marriage proposals|ja|縁談|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/marriage proposals|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/marriage proposals|qq=}}, anything long, [[:en:Blood vessel|blood vessels]], {{ill|hair|ja|毛髪|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/hair|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/hair|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 頭髪}}, [[:en:Small intestine|small intestine]], [[:en:Large intestine|large intestine]], [[:en:Bronchus|bronchi]], submersion, and the [[:en:Respiratory system|respiratory system]]. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰|1=Dragon (Zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)|2=ja|3=辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (Zodiac)|qq=}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳|1=Snake (Zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|2=ja|3=巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (Zodiac)|qq=}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=}}, the Metal element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:West|west]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kan (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kan (坎)|1=Kan (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Chen (辰)|ja|辰|1=Dragon (Zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)|2=ja|3=辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (辰)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (辰)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (Zodiac)|qq=}} (*tatsu*) and {{ill|Si (巳)|ja|巳|1=Snake (Zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|2=ja|3=巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (巳)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (巳)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (Zodiac)|qq=}} (*mi*), Xun is also read as *Tatsumi* (たつみ).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

{{Bagua|qq=}} '''Xun''' (巽) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|lt=巽為風|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.

== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

{{Bagua|qq=}} '''Xun''' (巽) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|lt=巽為風|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.

In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=}}, the Metal element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:West|west]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

{{Bagua|qq=}} '''Xun''' (巽) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|lt=巽為風|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Xun symbolizes [[:en:Wind|wind]] (also associated with {{ill|wood|ja|Wood (木)|1=Wood (wuxing)|1=Wood (wuxing)|lt=Wood (木)|2=uk|3=Дерево (елемент)|4=id|5=Kayu (Wu Xing)|6=ms|7=Kayu (Wu Xing)|8=bcl|9=Kahoy (wuxing)|10=ca|11=Fusta (wuxing)|12=it|13=Legno (elemento)|14=es|15=Madera (Wu Xing)|16=nl|17=Hout (element)|18=vi|19=Mộc (Ngũ hành)|20=tr|21=Tahta (klasik element)|22=ta|23=மரம் (சீன மெய்யியல்)|2=it|3=Legno (elemento)|4=es|5=Madera (Wu Xing)|6=tr|7=Tahta (klasik element)|1=Wood (wuxing)|1=Wood (wuxing)|lt=Wood (木)|2=uk|3=Дерево (елемент)|4=id|5=Kayu (Wu (木)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/wood|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/wood|13=User:Immanuelle/Wood (wuxing)|1=Wood (wuxing)|lt=Wood (木)|2=uk|3=Дерево (елемент)|4=id|5=Kayu (Wu Xing)|6=ms|7=Kayu (Wu Xing)|8=bcl|9=Kahoy (wuxing)|10=ca|11=Fusta (wuxing)|12=it|13=Legno (elemento)|14=es|15=Madera (Wu Xing)|16=nl|17=Hout (element)|18=vi|19=Mộc (Ngũ hành)|20=tr|21=Tahta (klasik element)|22=ta|23=மரம் (சீன மெய்யியல்)|2=it|3=Legno (elemento)|4=es|5=Madera (Wu Xing)|6=tr|7=Tahta (klasik element)|1=Wood (wuxing)|lt=Wood (木)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}), entry, [[:en:Chicken|chickens]], the thighs, the eldest daughter (a woman of {{ill|marriageable age|ja|結婚適齢期|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/marriageable age|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/marriageable age|qq=}}), {{ill|marriage proposals|ja|縁談|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/marriage proposals|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/marriage proposals|qq=}}, anything long, [[:en:Blood vessel|blood vessels]], {{ill|hair|ja|毛髪|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/hair|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/hair|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 頭髪}}, [[:en:Small intestine|small intestine]], [[:en:Large intestine|large intestine]], [[:en:Bronchus|bronchi]], submersion, and the [[:en:Respiratory system|respiratory system]]. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰|1=Dragon (Zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)|2=ja|3=辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (Zodiac)|qq=}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳|1=Snake (Zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|2=ja|3=巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (Zodiac)|qq=}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=}}, the Metal element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:West|west]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kan (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kan (坎)|1=Kan (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gen (Bagua)|2=ja|3=艮|lt=Gen (艮)|1=Gen (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhen (Bagua)|2=ja|3=震|lt=Zhen (震)|1=Zhen (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|1=Xun (Bagua)|lt=Xun|lt=Xun (☴)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|1=Li (Bagua)|2=ja|3=離|lt=Li {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|1=Kun (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坤|lt=Kun (坤)|1=Kun (Bagua)|lt=Kun|lt=Kun (☷)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|1=Dui (Bagua)|2=ja|3=兌|4=zh-yue|5=兌卦|6=ko|7=태 (괘)|8=fr|9=Duì|10=nl|11=Meer (trigram)|12=pt|13=Duì (I Ching)|14=zh-min-nan|15=Tōe-kòa|lt=Dui (兌)|1=Dui (Bagua)|2=ja|3=兌|4=zh-yue|5=兌卦|6=ko|7=태 (괘)|8=fr|9=Duì|10=nl|11=Meer (trigram)|12=pt|13=Duì (I Ching)|14=zh-min-nan|15=Tōe-kòa|lt=Dui (兌)|1=Dui {{ill|Qian|ja|乾|1=Qian (Bagua)|2=ja|3=乾|lt=Qian (乾)|1=Qian (Bagua)|lt=Qian|lt=Qian (☰)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian (Bagua)|qq=}}—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Chen (辰)|ja|辰|1=Dragon (Zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)|2=ja|3=辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (辰)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (辰)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (Zodiac)|qq=}} (*tatsu*) and {{ill|Si (巳)|ja|巳|1=Snake (Zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|2=ja|3=巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (巳)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (巳)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (Zodiac)|qq=}} (*mi*), Xun is also read as *Tatsumi* (たつみ).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

{{Bagua|qq=}} '''Xun''' (巽) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|lt=巽為風|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.

As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰|1=Dragon (Zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)|2=ja|3=辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (Zodiac)|qq=}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳|1=Snake (Zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|2=ja|3=巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (Zodiac)|qq=}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=}}, the Metal element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:West|west]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

{{Bagua|qq=}} '''Xun''' (巽) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|lt=巽為風|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.

In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=}}, the Metal element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:West|west]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

{{Bagua|qq=}} '''Xun''' (巽) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|lt=巽為風|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.

In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=}}, the Metal element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:West|west]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kan (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kan (坎)|1=Kan (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q2544836]] Wikidata name: xùn [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 10:22, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Xun''' (巽) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|lt=巽為風|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Xun symbolizes [[:en:Wind|wind]] (also associated with {{ill|wood|ja|Wood (木)|1=Wood (wuxing)|1=Wood (wuxing)|lt=Wood (木)|2=uk|3=Дерево (елемент)|4=id|5=Kayu (Wu Xing)|6=ms|7=Kayu (Wu Xing)|8=bcl|9=Kahoy (wuxing)|10=ca|11=Fusta (wuxing)|12=it|13=Legno (elemento)|14=es|15=Madera (Wu Xing)|16=nl|17=Hout (element)|18=vi|19=Mộc (Ngũ hành)|20=tr|21=Tahta (klasik [[:en:Chicken|chickens]], the thighs, the eldest daughter (a woman of {{ill|marriageable age|ja|結婚適齢期|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/marriageable age|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/marriageable age|qq=}}), {{ill|marriage proposals|ja|縁談|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/marriage proposals|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/marriage proposals|qq=}}, anything long, [[:en:Blood vessel|blood vessels]], {{ill|hair|ja|毛髪|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/hair|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/hair|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 頭髪}}, [[:en:Small intestine|small intestine]], [[:en:Large intestine|large intestine]], [[:en:Bronchus|bronchi]], submersion, and the [[:en:Respiratory system|respiratory system]]. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰|1=Dragon (Zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)|2=ja|3=辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (Zodiac)|qq=}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳|1=Snake (Zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|2=ja|3=巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (Zodiac)|qq=}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=}}, the Metal element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:West|west]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kan (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kan (坎)|1=Kan (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Chen (辰)|ja|辰|1=Dragon (Zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)|2=ja|3=辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (辰)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (辰)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (Zodiac)|qq=}} (*tatsu*) and {{ill|Si (巳)|ja|巳|1=Snake (Zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|2=ja|3=巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (巳)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (巳)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (Zodiac)|qq=}} (*mi*), Xun is also read as *Tatsumi* (たつみ).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|lt=巽為風|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.

== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kan (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰|1=Dragon (Zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)|2=ja|3=辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (Zodiac)|qq=}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳|1=Snake (Zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|2=ja|3=巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (Zodiac)|qq=}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=}}, the Metal element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:West|west]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|lt=巽為風|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.

In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=}}, the Metal element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:West|west]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kan (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q2544836]] Wikidata name: xùn [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 10:22, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Xun''' (巽) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|lt=巽為風|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Xun symbolizes [[:en:Wind|wind]] (also associated with {{ill|wood|ja|Wood (木)|1=Wood (wuxing)|1=Wood (wuxing)|lt=Wood (木)|2=uk|3=Дерево (елемент)|4=id|5=Kayu (Wu proposals|qq=}}, anything long, [[:en:Blood vessel|blood vessels]], {{ill|hair|ja|毛髪|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/hair|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/hair|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 頭髪}}, [[:en:Small intestine|small intestine]], [[:en:Large intestine|large intestine]], [[:en:Bronchus|bronchi]], submersion, and the [[:en:Respiratory system|respiratory system]]. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰|1=Dragon (Zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)|2=ja|3=辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (Zodiac)|qq=}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳|1=Snake (Zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|2=ja|3=巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (Zodiac)|qq=}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=}}, the Metal element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:West|west]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kan (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|lt=巽為風|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.

In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=}}, the Metal element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:West|west]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kan (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|lt=巽為風|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.

In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=}}, the Metal element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:West|west]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kan (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|lt=巽為風|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.

In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=}}, the Metal element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:West|west]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kan (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|lt=巽為風|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.

In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=}}, the Metal element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:West|west]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kan (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|lt=巽為風|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.

In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=}}, the Metal element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:West|west]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|lt=巽為風|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.

In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=}}, the Metal element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:West|west]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|lt=巽為風|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.

In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=}}, the Metal element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:West|west]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|1=Xun (Bagua)|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|lt=巽為風|qq=draft|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.
