(சீன மெய்யியல்)|2=it|3=Legno (elemento)|4=es|5=Madera (Wu Xing)|6=tr|7=Tahta (klasik element)|1=Wood (wuxing)|lt=Wood (木)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}), entry, [[:en:Chicken|chickens]], the thighs, the eldest daughter (a woman of {{ill|marriageable age|ja|結婚適齢期|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/marriageable age|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/marriageable age|qq=}}), {{ill|marriage proposals|ja|縁談|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/marriage proposals|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/marriage proposals|1=marriage proposals|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q97312246}}, anything long, [[:en:Blood vessel|blood vessels]], {{ill|hair|ja|毛髪|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/hair|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/hair|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 頭髪|1=head hair|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q336128}}, [[:en:Small intestine|small intestine]], [[:en:Large intestine|large intestine]], [[:en:Bronchus|bronchi]], submersion, and the [[:en:Respiratory system|respiratory system]]. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東|1=southeast|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6452640}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰|1=chén|lt=Dragon (辰)|2=ja|3=辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (zodiac)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (Zodiac)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q16538966}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳|1=Snake (Zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|2=ja|3=巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (zodiac)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (Zodiac)|qq=}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=}}, the Metal element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:West|west]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東|1=southeast|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6452640}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|1=xùn|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|lt=巽為風|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q2544836}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Xun symbolizes [[:en:Wind|wind]] (also associated with {{ill|wood|ja|Wood (木)|1=Wood (wuxing)|1=Wood (wuxing)|lt=Wood (木)|2=uk|3=Дерево (елемент)|4=id|5=Kayu (Wu thighs, the eldest daughter (a woman of {{ill|marriageable age|ja|結婚適齢期|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/marriageable age|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/marriageable age|qq=}}), {{ill|marriage on wikidata|WD=Q336128}}, [[:en:Small intestine|small intestine]], [[:en:Large intestine|large intestine]], [[:en:Bronchus|bronchi]], submersion, and the [[:en:Respiratory system|respiratory system]]. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東|1=southeast|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6452640}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰|1=chén|lt=Dragon (辰)|2=ja|3=辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (zodiac)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (Zodiac)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q16538966}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳|1=Snake (Zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|2=ja|3=巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (zodiac)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (Zodiac)|qq=}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=}}, the Metal element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:West|west]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東|1=southeast|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6452640}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=艮|lt=Gen (艮)|1=Gèn (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=震|lt=Zhèn (震)|1=Zhèn directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Chen (辰)|ja|辰|1=chén|lt=Dragon (辰)|2=ja|3=辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (辰)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (zodiac)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (辰)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (Zodiac)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q16538966}} (*tatsu*) and {{ill|Si (巳)|ja|巳|1=Snake (Zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|2=ja|3=巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (巳)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (zodiac)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (巳)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (Zodiac)|qq=}} (*mi*), Xun is also read as *Tatsumi* (たつみ).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|1=xùn|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|lt=巽為風|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q2544836}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.

In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=}}, the Metal element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:West|west]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東|1=southeast|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6452640}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東|1=southeast|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6452640}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|1=xùn|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|lt=巽為風|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q2544836}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.

In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=}}, the Metal element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:West|west]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東|1=southeast|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6452640}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|1=xùn|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|lt=巽為風|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q2544836}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.

In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=}}, the Metal element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:West|west]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東|1=southeast|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6452640}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=}}, the Metal element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:West|west]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東|1=southeast|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6452640}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|1=xùn|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|lt=巽為風|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q2544836}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Xun symbolizes [[:en:Wind|wind]] (also associated with {{ill|wood|ja|Wood (木)|1=Wood (wuxing)|1=Wood (wuxing)|lt=Wood (木)|2=uk|3=Дерево (елемент)|4=id|5=Kayu (Wu thighs, the eldest daughter (a woman of {{ill|marriageable age|ja|結婚適齢期|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/marriageable age|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/marriageable age|qq=}}), {{ill|marriage on wikidata|WD=Q336128}}, [[:en:Small intestine|small intestine]], [[:en:Large intestine|large intestine]], [[:en:Bronchus|bronchi]], submersion, and the [[:en:Respiratory system|respiratory system]]. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東|1=southeast|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6452640}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰|1=chén|lt=Dragon (辰)|2=ja|3=辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (zodiac)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (Zodiac)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q16538966}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳|1=Snake (Zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|2=ja|3=巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (zodiac)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (Zodiac)|qq=}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=}}, the Metal element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:West|west]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東|1=southeast|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6452640}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=艮|lt=Gen (艮)|1=Gèn (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=震|lt=Zhèn (震)|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Chen (辰)|ja|辰|1=chén|lt=Dragon (辰)|2=ja|3=辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (辰)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (zodiac)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (辰)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (Zodiac)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q16538966}} (*tatsu*) and {{ill|Si (巳)|ja|巳|1=Snake (Zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|2=ja|3=巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (巳)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (zodiac)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (巳)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (Zodiac)|qq=}} (*mi*), Xun is also read as *Tatsumi* (たつみ).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|1=xùn|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|lt=巽為風|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q2544836}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.

In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=}}, the Metal element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:West|west]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東|1=southeast|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6452640}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|1=xùn|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|lt=巽為風|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q2544836}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Xun symbolizes [[:en:Wind|wind]] (also associated with {{ill|wood|ja|Wood (木)|1=Wood (wuxing)|1=Wood (wuxing)|lt=Wood (木)|2=uk|3=Дерево (елемент)|4=id|5=Kayu (Wu Xing)|6=ms|7=Kayu (Wu Xing)|8=bcl|9=Kahoy (wuxing)|10=ca|11=Fusta (wuxing)|12=it|13=Legno (elemento)|14=es|15=Madera (Wu Xing)|16=nl|17=Hout (element)|18=vi|19=Mộc (Ngũ hành)|20=tr|21=Tahta (klasik element)|22=ta|23=மரம் (சீன மெய்யியல்)|2=it|3=Legno (elemento)|4=es|5=Madera (Wu Xing)|6=tr|7=Tahta (klasik element)|1=Wood (wuxing)|lt=Wood (木)|lt=Wood (木)|2=uk|3=Дерево (елемент)|4=id|5=Kayu (Wu element)|22=ta|23=மரம் (சீன மெய்யியல்)|2=it|3=Legno (elemento)|4=es|5=Madera (Wu Xing)|6=tr|7=Tahta (klasik element)|1=Wood (wuxing)|1=Wood (wuxing)|lt=Wood (木)|2=uk|3=Дерево (елемент)|4=id|5=Kayu (Wu element)|22=ta|23=மரம் (சீன மெய்யியல்)|2=it|3=Legno (elemento)|4=es|5=Madera (Wu Xing)|6=tr|7=Tahta (klasik element)|1=Wood (wuxing)|lt=Wood (木)|lt=Wood (木)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/wood|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/wood|13=User:Immanuelle/Wood (wuxing)|1=Wood (wuxing)|lt=Wood (木)|2=uk|3=Дерево (елемент)|4=id|5=Kayu (Wu Xing)|6=ms|7=Kayu (Wu Xing)|8=bcl|9=Kahoy (wuxing)|10=ca|11=Fusta (wuxing)|12=it|13=Legno (elemento)|14=es|15=Madera (Wu Xing)|16=nl|17=Hout (element)|18=vi|19=Mộc (Ngũ hành)|20=tr|21=Tahta (klasik element)|22=ta|23=மரம் (சீன மெய்யியல்)|2=it|3=Legno (elemento)|4=es|5=Madera (Wu Xing)|6=tr|7=Tahta (klasik element)|1=Wood (wuxing)|lt=Wood (木)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}), entry, [[:en:Chicken|chickens]], the thighs, the eldest daughter (a woman of {{ill|marriageable age|ja|結婚適齢期|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/marriageable age|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/marriageable age|qq=}}), {{ill|marriage proposals|ja|縁談|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/marriage proposals|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/marriage proposals|1=marriage proposals|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q97312246}}, anything long, [[:en:Blood vessel|blood vessels]], {{ill|hair|ja|毛髪|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/hair|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/hair|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 頭髪|1=head hair|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q336128}}, [[:en:Small intestine|small intestine]], [[:en:Large intestine|large intestine]], [[:en:Bronchus|bronchi]], submersion, and the [[:en:Respiratory system|respiratory system]]. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東|1=southeast|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6452640}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰|1=chén|lt=Dragon (辰)|2=ja|3=辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (zodiac)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (Zodiac)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q16538966}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳|1=Snake (Zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|2=ja|3=巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (zodiac)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (Zodiac)|qq=}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=}}, the Metal element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:West|west]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東|1=southeast|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6452640}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|1=xùn|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|lt=巽為風|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q2544836}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Xun symbolizes [[:en:Wind|wind]] (also associated with {{ill|wood|ja|Wood (木)|1=Wood (wuxing)|1=Wood (wuxing)|lt=Wood (木)|2=uk|3=Дерево (елемент)|4=id|5=Kayu (Wu Xing)|6=ms|7=Kayu (Wu Xing)|8=bcl|9=Kahoy (wuxing)|10=ca|11=Fusta (wuxing)|12=it|13=Legno (elemento)|14=es|15=Madera (Wu Xing)|16=nl|17=Hout (element)|18=vi|19=Mộc (Ngũ hành)|20=tr|21=Tahta (klasik (சீன மெய்யியல்)|2=it|3=Legno (elemento)|4=es|5=Madera (Wu Xing)|6=tr|7=Tahta (klasik element)|1=Wood (wuxing)|lt=Wood (木)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}), entry, [[:en:Chicken|chickens]], the thighs, the eldest daughter (a woman of {{ill|marriageable age|ja|結婚適齢期|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/marriageable age|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/marriageable age|qq=}}), {{ill|marriage proposals|ja|縁談|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/marriage proposals|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/marriage proposals|1=marriage proposals|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q97312246}}, anything long, [[:en:Blood vessel|blood vessels]], {{ill|hair|ja|毛髪|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/hair|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/hair|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 頭髪|1=head hair|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q336128}}, [[:en:Small intestine|small intestine]], [[:en:Large intestine|large intestine]], [[:en:Bronchus|bronchi]], submersion, and the [[:en:Respiratory system|respiratory system]]. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東|1=southeast|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6452640}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰|1=chén|lt=Dragon (辰)|2=ja|3=辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (zodiac)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (Zodiac)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q16538966}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳|1=Snake (Zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|2=ja|3=巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (zodiac)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (Zodiac)|qq=}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=}}, the Metal element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:West|west]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東|1=southeast|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6452640}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=艮|lt=Gen (艮)|1=Gèn (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=震|lt=Zhèn (震)|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Dui|13=User:Immanuelle/Duì (Bagua)|qq=}}, and {{ill|Qian|ja|乾|1=Qián (Bagua)|2=ja|3=乾|lt=Qian (乾)|1=Qián (Bagua)|lt=Qian|lt=Qian (☰)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|qq=}}—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Chen (辰)|ja|辰|1=chén|lt=Dragon (辰)|2=ja|3=辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (辰)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (zodiac)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (辰)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (Zodiac)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q16538966}} (*tatsu*) and {{ill|Si (巳)|ja|巳|1=Snake (Zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|2=ja|3=巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (巳)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (zodiac)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (巳)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (Zodiac)|qq=}} (*mi*), Xun is also read as *Tatsumi* (たつみ).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東|1=southeast|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6452640}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|1=xùn|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|lt=巽為風|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q2544836}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.

long, [[:en:Blood vessel|blood vessels]], {{ill|hair|ja|毛髪|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/hair|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/hair|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 頭髪|1=head hair|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q336128}}, [[:en:Small intestine|small intestine]], [[:en:Large intestine|large intestine]], [[:en:Bronchus|bronchi]], submersion, and the [[:en:Respiratory system|respiratory system]]. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東|1=southeast|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6452640}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰|1=chén|lt=Dragon (辰)|2=ja|3=辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (zodiac)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (Zodiac)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q16538966}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳|1=Snake (Zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|2=ja|3=巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (zodiac)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (Zodiac)|qq=}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=}}, the Metal element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:West|west]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東|1=southeast|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6452640}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|1=xùn|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|lt=巽為風|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q2544836}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.

In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=}}, the Metal element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:West|west]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東|1=southeast|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6452640}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東|1=southeast|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6452640}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=}}, the Metal element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:West|west]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東|1=southeast|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6452640}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|1=xùn|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|lt=巽為風|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q2544836}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Xun symbolizes [[:en:Wind|wind]] (also associated with {{ill|wood|ja|Wood (木)|1=Wood (wuxing)|1=Wood (wuxing)|lt=Wood (木)|2=uk|3=Дерево (елемент)|4=id|5=Kayu (Wu Xing)|6=ms|7=Kayu (Wu Xing)|8=bcl|9=Kahoy (wuxing)|10=ca|11=Fusta (wuxing)|12=it|13=Legno (elemento)|14=es|15=Madera (Wu Xing)|16=nl|17=Hout (element)|18=vi|19=Mộc (Ngũ hành)|20=tr|21=Tahta (klasik (சீன மெய்யியல்)|2=it|3=Legno (elemento)|4=es|5=Madera (Wu Xing)|6=tr|7=Tahta (klasik element)|1=Wood (wuxing)|lt=Wood (木)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}), entry, [[:en:Chicken|chickens]], the thighs, the eldest daughter (a woman of {{ill|marriageable age|ja|結婚適齢期|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/marriageable age|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/marriageable age|qq=}}), {{ill|marriage proposals|ja|縁談|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/marriage proposals|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/marriage proposals|1=marriage proposals|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q97312246}}, anything long, [[:en:Blood vessel|blood vessels]], {{ill|hair|ja|毛髪|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/hair|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/hair|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 頭髪|1=head hair|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q336128}}, [[:en:Small intestine|small intestine]], [[:en:Large intestine|large intestine]], [[:en:Bronchus|bronchi]], submersion, and the [[:en:Respiratory system|respiratory system]]. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東|1=southeast|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6452640}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰|1=chén|lt=Dragon (辰)|2=ja|3=辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (zodiac)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (Zodiac)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q16538966}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳|1=Snake (Zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|2=ja|3=巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (zodiac)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (Zodiac)|qq=}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=}}, the Metal element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:West|west]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東|1=southeast|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6452640}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=艮|lt=Gen (艮)|1=Gèn (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=震|lt=Zhèn (震)|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|1=xùn|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|1=Xun (Bagua)|lt=Xun|lt=Xun (☴)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|1=Kūn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坤|lt=Kūn (坤)|1=Kūn (Bagua)|lt=Kun|lt=Kun (☷)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun|13=User:Immanuelle/Kūn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun|13=User:Immanuelle/Kūn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|1=Duì (Bagua)|2=ja|3=兌|4=zh-yue|5=兌卦|6=ko|7=태 (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Dui|13=User:Immanuelle/Duì (Bagua)|qq=}}, and {{ill|Qian|ja|乾|1=Qián (Bagua)|2=ja|3=乾|lt=Qian (乾)|1=Qián (Bagua)|lt=Qian|lt=Qian (☰)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|qq=}}—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Chen (辰)|ja|辰|1=chén|lt=Dragon (辰)|2=ja|3=辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (辰)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (zodiac)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (辰)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (Zodiac)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q16538966}} (*tatsu*) and {{ill|Si (巳)|ja|巳|1=Snake (Zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|2=ja|3=巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (巳)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (zodiac)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (巳)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (Zodiac)|qq=}} (*mi*), Xun is also read as *Tatsumi* (たつみ).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|1=xùn|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|lt=巽為風|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q2544836}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Xun symbolizes [[:en:Wind|wind]] (also associated with {{ill|wood|ja|Wood (木)|1=Wood (wuxing)|1=Wood (wuxing)|lt=Wood (木)|2=uk|3=Дерево (елемент)|4=id|5=Kayu (Wu element)|22=ta|23=மரம் (சீன மெய்யியல்)|2=it|3=Legno (elemento)|4=es|5=Madera (Wu Xing)|6=tr|7=Tahta (klasik element)|1=Wood (wuxing)|lt=Wood (木)|lt=Wood (木)|2=uk|3=Дерево (елемент)|4=id|5=Kayu (Wu element)|22=ta|23=மரம் (சீன மெய்யியல்)|2=it|3=Legno (elemento)|4=es|5=Madera (Wu Xing)|6=tr|7=Tahta (klasik element)|1=Wood (wuxing)|lt=Wood (木)|lt=Wood (木)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/wood|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/wood|13=User:Immanuelle/Wood (wuxing)|1=Wood (wuxing)|lt=Wood (木)|2=uk|3=Дерево (елемент)|4=id|5=Kayu (Wu Xing)|6=ms|7=Kayu (Wu (சீன மெய்யியல்)|2=it|3=Legno (elemento)|4=es|5=Madera (Wu Xing)|6=tr|7=Tahta (klasik element)|1=Wood (wuxing)|lt=Wood (木)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}), entry, [[:en:Chicken|chickens]], the thighs, the eldest daughter (a woman of {{ill|marriageable age|ja|結婚適齢期|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/marriageable age|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/marriageable age|qq=}}), {{ill|marriage proposals|ja|縁談|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/marriage proposals|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/marriage proposals|1=marriage proposals|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q97312246}}, anything long, [[:en:Blood vessel|blood vessels]], {{ill|hair|ja|毛髪|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/hair|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/hair|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 頭髪|1=head hair|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q336128}}, [[:en:Small intestine|small intestine]], [[:en:Large intestine|large intestine]], [[:en:Bronchus|bronchi]], submersion, and the [[:en:Respiratory system|respiratory system]]. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東|1=southeast|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6452640}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰|1=chén|lt=Dragon (辰)|2=ja|3=辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (zodiac)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (Zodiac)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q16538966}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳|1=Snake (Zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|2=ja|3=巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (zodiac)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (Zodiac)|qq=}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=}}, the Metal element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:West|west]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東|1=southeast|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6452640}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|1=xùn|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|lt=巽為風|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q2544836}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.

In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=}}, the Metal element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:West|west]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東|1=southeast|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6452640}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東|1=southeast|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6452640}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=}}, the Metal element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:West|west]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東|1=southeast|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6452640}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|1=xùn|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|lt=巽為風|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q2544836}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Xun symbolizes [[:en:Wind|wind]] (also associated with {{ill|wood|ja|Wood (木)|1=Wood (wuxing)|1=Wood (wuxing)|lt=Wood (木)|2=uk|3=Дерево (елемент)|4=id|5=Kayu (Wu Xing)|6=ms|7=Kayu (Wu Xing)|8=bcl|9=Kahoy (wuxing)|10=ca|11=Fusta (wuxing)|12=it|13=Legno (elemento)|14=es|15=Madera (Wu Xing)|16=nl|17=Hout (element)|18=vi|19=Mộc (Ngũ hành)|20=tr|21=Tahta (klasik thighs, the eldest daughter (a woman of {{ill|marriageable age|ja|結婚適齢期|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/marriageable age|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/marriageable age|qq=}}), {{ill|marriage proposals|ja|縁談|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/marriage proposals|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/marriage proposals|1=marriage proposals|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q97312246}}, anything long, [[:en:Blood vessel|blood vessels]], {{ill|hair|ja|毛髪|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/hair|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/hair|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 頭髪|1=head hair|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q336128}}, [[:en:Small intestine|small intestine]], [[:en:Large intestine|large intestine]], [[:en:Bronchus|bronchi]], submersion, and the [[:en:Respiratory system|respiratory system]]. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東|1=southeast|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6452640}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰|1=chén|lt=Dragon (辰)|2=ja|3=辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (zodiac)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (Zodiac)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q16538966}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳|1=Snake (Zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|2=ja|3=巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (zodiac)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (Zodiac)|qq=}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=}}, the Metal element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:West|west]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東|1=southeast|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6452640}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=艮|lt=Gen (艮)|1=Gèn (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=震|lt=Zhèn (震)|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|1=xùn|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|1=Xun (Bagua)|lt=Xun|lt=Xun (☴)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (☰)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|qq=}}—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Chen (辰)|ja|辰|1=chén|lt=Dragon (辰)|2=ja|3=辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (辰)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (zodiac)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (辰)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (Zodiac)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q16538966}} (*tatsu*) and {{ill|Si (巳)|ja|巳|1=Snake (Zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|2=ja|3=巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (巳)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (zodiac)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (巳)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (Zodiac)|qq=}} (*mi*), Xun is also read as *Tatsumi* (たつみ).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東|1=southeast|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6452640}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=}}, the Metal element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:West|west]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東|1=southeast|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6452640}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=}}, the Metal element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:West|west]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東|1=southeast|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6452640}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

'''Xun''' (巽) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|en|Bagua|WD=Q340846|lt=Bagua}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Hexagram (I Ching)|en|Hexagram (I Ching)|WD=Q1572403|lt=Sixty-Four Hexagrams}}, known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|1=xùn|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|lt=巽為風|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q2544836}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.

== Trigram Symbolism ==

proposals|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q97312246}}, anything long, {{ill|Blood vessel|en|Blood vessel|WD=Q988343|lt=blood vessels}},
