and the {{ill|Respiratory system|en|Respiratory system|WD=Q7891|lt=respiratory system}}. As a {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five directions}}, it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東|1=southeast|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6452640}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰|1=chén|lt=Dragon (辰)|2=ja|3=辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (zodiac)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (Zodiac)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q16538966}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳|1=Snake (Zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|2=ja|3=巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (zodiac)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (Zodiac)|qq=}}.

In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=}}, the Metal element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|WD=Q218652|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)}}, and the {{ill|West|en|West|WD=Q679|lt=west}} among the {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five Directions}}.

== Direction ==
As a {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five directions}}, Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東|1=southeast|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6452640}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|WD=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branches}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=艮|lt=Gen (艮)|1=Gèn (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=震|lt=Zhèn (震)|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, == Earlier Heaven Arrangement ==
In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

{{Bagua|qq=}}
'''Xun''' (巽) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|en|Bagua|WD=Q340846|lt=Bagua}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Hexagram (I Ching)|en|Hexagram (I Ching)|WD=Q1572403|lt=Sixty-Four Hexagrams}}, known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|1=xùn|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|lt=巽為風|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q2544836}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.

== Trigram Symbolism ==

{{ill|Chicken|en|Chicken|WD=Q780|lt=chickens}}, the thighs, the eldest daughter (a woman of {{ill|marriageable age|ja|結婚適齢期|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/marriageable age|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/marriageable age|qq=}}), {{ill|marriage proposals|ja|縁談|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/marriage proposals|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/marriage proposals|1=marriage proposals|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q97312246}}, anything long, {{ill|Blood vessel|en|Blood vessel|WD=Q988343|lt=blood vessels}}, {{ill|hair|ja|毛髪|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/hair|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/hair|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 頭髪|1=head hair|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q336128}}, {{ill|Small intestine|en|Small intestine|WD=Q11090|lt=small intestine}}, {{ill|Large intestine|en|Large intestine|WD=Q11083|lt=large intestine}}, {{ill|Bronchus|en|Bronchus|WD=Q181602|lt=bronchi}}, submersion, and the {{ill|Respiratory system|en|Respiratory system|WD=Q7891|lt=respiratory system}}. As a {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five directions}}, it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東|1=southeast|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6452640}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰|1=chén|lt=Dragon (辰)|2=ja|3=辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (zodiac)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (Zodiac)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q16538966}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳|1=Snake (Zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|2=ja|3=巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (zodiac)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (Zodiac)|qq=}}.

In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=}}, the Metal element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|WD=Q218652|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)}}, and the {{ill|West|en|West|WD=Q679|lt=west}} among the {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five Directions}}.

== Direction ==
As a {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five directions}}, Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東|1=southeast|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6452640}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|WD=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branches}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=艮|lt=Gen (艮)|1=Gèn (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=震|lt=Zhèn (震)|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, == Earlier Heaven Arrangement ==
In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

Because it lies between {{ill|Chen (辰)|ja|辰|1=chén|lt=Dragon (辰)|2=ja|3=辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (辰)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (zodiac)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (辰)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (Zodiac)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q16538966}} (*tatsu*) and {{ill|Si (巳)|ja|巳|1=Snake (Zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|2=ja|3=巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (巳)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (zodiac)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (巳)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (Zodiac)|qq=}} (*mi*), Xun is also read as *Tatsumi* (たつみ).

== Earlier Heaven Arrangement ==
In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

{{Bagua|qq=}}
'''Xun''' (巽) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|en|Bagua|WD=Q340846|lt=Bagua}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Hexagram (I Ching)|en|Hexagram (I Ching)|WD=Q1572403|lt=Sixty-Four Hexagrams}}, known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|1=xùn|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|lt=巽為風|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q2544836}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.

== Trigram Symbolism ==

== Direction ==
As a {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five directions}}, Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東|1=southeast|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6452640}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|WD=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branches}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn == Earlier Heaven Arrangement ==
In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

{{Bagua|qq=}}
'''Xun''' (巽) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|en|Bagua|WD=Q340846|lt=Bagua}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Hexagram (I Ching)|en|Hexagram (I Ching)|WD=Q1572403|lt=Sixty-Four Hexagrams}}, known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|1=xùn|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|lt=巽為風|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q2544836}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.

== Trigram Symbolism ==

and the {{ill|Respiratory system|en|Respiratory system|WD=Q7891|lt=respiratory system}}. As a {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five directions}}, it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東|1=southeast|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6452640}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰|1=chén|lt=Dragon (辰)|2=ja|3=辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (zodiac)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (Zodiac)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q16538966}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳|1=Snake (Zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|2=ja|3=巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (zodiac)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (Zodiac)|qq=}}.

In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=}}, the Metal element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|WD=Q218652|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)}}, and the {{ill|West|en|West|WD=Q679|lt=west}} among the {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five Directions}}.

== Direction ==
As a {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five directions}}, Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東|1=southeast|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6452640}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|WD=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branches}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=艮|lt=Gen (艮)|1=Gèn (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=震|lt=Zhèn (震)|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|1=xùn|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|1=Xun (Bagua)|lt=Xun|lt=Xun (☴)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun Because it lies between {{ill|Chen (辰)|ja|辰|1=chén|lt=Dragon (辰)|2=ja|3=辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (辰)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (zodiac)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (辰)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (Zodiac)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q16538966}} (*tatsu*) and {{ill|Si (巳)|ja|巳|1=Snake (Zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|2=ja|3=巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (巳)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (zodiac)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (巳)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (Zodiac)|qq=}} (*mi*), Xun is also read as *Tatsumi* (たつみ).

== Earlier Heaven Arrangement ==
In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

As a {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five directions}}, it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東|1=southeast|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6452640}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰|1=chén|lt=Dragon (辰)|2=ja|3=辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (zodiac)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (Zodiac)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q16538966}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳|1=Snake (Zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|2=ja|3=巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (zodiac)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (Zodiac)|qq=}}.

In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=}}, the Metal element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|WD=Q218652|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)}}, and the {{ill|West|en|West|WD=Q679|lt=west}} among the {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five Directions}}.

== Direction ==
As a {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five directions}}, Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東|1=southeast|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6452640}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|WD=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branches}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn == Earlier Heaven Arrangement ==
In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

'''Xun''' (巽) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|en|Bagua|WD=Q340846|lt=Bagua}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Hexagram (I Ching)|en|Hexagram (I Ching)|WD=Q1572403|lt=Sixty-Four Hexagrams}}, known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|1=xùn|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|lt=巽為風|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q2544836}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.

== Direction ==
As a {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five directions}}, Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東|1=southeast|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6452640}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|WD=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branches}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn == Earlier Heaven Arrangement ==
In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

'''Xun''' (巽) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|en|Bagua|WD=Q340846|lt=Bagua|1=Bagua}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Hexagram (I Ching)|en|Hexagram (I Ching)|WD=Q1572403|lt=Sixty-Four Hexagrams|1=Hexagram (I Ching)}}, known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|1=Xùn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|lt=巽為風|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q2544836}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.

As a {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five directions|1=Cardinal direction}}, it represents the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東|1=Southeast|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6452640}}, specifically the area between {{ill|Chen (Earthly Branch)|ja|辰|1=chén|lt=Dragon (辰)|2=ja|3=辰|1=Dragon (zodiac)|lt=Dragon (辰)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (zodiac)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chen (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon (Zodiac)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q16538966}} and {{ill|Si (Earthly Branch)|ja|巳|1=Snake (Zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|2=ja|3=巳|1=Snake (zodiac)|lt=Snake (巳)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (zodiac)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Si (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Snake (Zodiac)|qq=}}.

In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=}}, the Metal element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|WD=Q218652|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)}}, and the {{ill|West|en|West|WD=Q679|lt=west|1=West}} among the {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five Directions|1=Cardinal direction}}.

== Direction ==
As a {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five directions|1=Cardinal direction}}, Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東|1=Southeast|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6452640}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|WD=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branches|1=Earthly Branches}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn == Earlier Heaven Arrangement ==
In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528|1=Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|1=Q11627311|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

'''Xun''' (巽) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|en|Bagua|WD=Q340846|lt=Bagua|1=Bagua}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Hexagram (I Ching)|en|Hexagram (I Ching)|WD=Q1572403|lt=Sixty-Four Hexagrams|1=Hexagram (I Ching)}}, known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|1=Xùn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|lt=巽為風|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q2544836}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.

== Direction ==
As a {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five directions|1=Cardinal direction}}, Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東|1=Southeast|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6452640}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|WD=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branches|1=Earthly Branches}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. == Earlier Heaven Arrangement ==
In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528|1=Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|1=Q11627311|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Xun is associated with {{ill|Xin (Heavenly Stem)|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanoto (辛)|qq=}}, the Metal element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|WD=Q218652|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)}}, and the {{ill|West|en|West|WD=Q679|lt=west|1=West}} among the {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five Directions|1=Cardinal direction}}.

== Direction ==
As a {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five directions|1=Cardinal direction}}, Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東|1=Southeast|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6452640}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|WD=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branches|1=Earthly Branches}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (☶)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=震|lt=Zhèn (震)|1=Zhèn == Earlier Heaven Arrangement ==
In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528|1=Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|1=Q11627311|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.

'''Xun''' (巽) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|en|Bagua|WD=Q340846|lt=Bagua|1=Bagua}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☴'''|qq=}} with the first {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}} being Yin (⚋) and the second and third Yao being Yang (⚊). It is also one of the {{ill|Hexagram (I Ching)|en|Hexagram (I Ching)|WD=Q1572403|lt=Sixty-Four Hexagrams|1=Hexagram (I Ching)}}, known as {{ill|Xun (Bagua)|ja|巽|1=Xùn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|lt=巽為風|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun (Bagua)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q2544836}}, consisting of Xun below and Xun above.

== Direction ==
As a {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five directions|1=Cardinal direction}}, Xun corresponds to the {{ill|southeast|ja|東南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southeast|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 南東|1=Southeast|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6452640}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|WD=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branches|1=Earthly Branches}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. == Earlier Heaven Arrangement ==
In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528|1=Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua}}, Xun is the fifth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four corner trigrams, representing {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|1=Q11627311|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the emergence of one Yin.
